description: Reviewed untranslated-text ratchet after Remote Support Phases 4-8 integration and Render logging Phases 1-3. The additional backend literal is the internal logger serialization fallback emitted only when JSON encoding itself fails; it is technical observability output rather than user-facing ERP content. Existing bounded API, authorization, rollout-readiness, rollback, sales/POS, and shared UI literals remain covered by the dedicated English, Arabic, and French dictionaries. No business content, stock item names, or stock group names are translated by this change.
